svg.title: Untitled
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Brown wash occupies a bent angular polygon on full paper sheet. Wash variation and pencil outline are simplified; corners traced from primary sale image.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/buy/auction/2021/contemporary-art-day-auction-5/untitled-17; record sothebys-en-buy-auction-2021-contemporary-art-day-auction-5-untitled-17; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
